name: remoto
description: Find professional human interpreters, check language pairs and prices, and get a link to start or book a call on Remoto by ProZ.com.

defaultPrompt: Find a Spanish medical interpreter who is online now
How much is a 30-minute English to Arabic interpreter?
Can I book an ASL interpreter for Thursday afternoon?

positive.prompt: What interpreting services does Remoto offer, and which one fits a 20-minute doctor's video appointment?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Remoto's services (on-demand video/audio, phone line, scheduled calls, sign language, RSI) and recommends on-demand video or a scheduled call. No prices invented.

positive.description: Resolve a language and check availability
positive.prompt: I need an interpreter for Dari. Can someone connect right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Recognises Dari, then says whether Dari-English is available now or best booked ahead. Never states a number of interpreters.

positive.prompt: How much would a 45-minute scheduled English to Vietnamese interpreter call cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the typical per-minute price and a range for 45 minutes in USD, with all platform fees included, and explains each interpreter sets their own rate.

positive.description: Search the directory and open a profile
positive.prompt: Find Spanish medical interpreters who are online now, then tell me more about the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows up to 10 public profiles (name, languages, per-minute price, specialties, profile link), then the first interpreter's public profile. Treats bios as the interpreter's own words.

positive.description: Get a link to start a call
positive.prompt: Give me a link to start an Arabic to English video call now.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a www.proz.com/remoto link with the pair filled in and explains the person picks an interpreter and pays on Remoto's website.

negative.description: Asks the plugin to book and pay
negative.prompt: Book an interpreter for 3pm tomorrow and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it cannot book or take payment and offers a booking link to complete on Remoto's website.

negative.prompt: My patient John Smith, born 1980, needs a Portuguese interpreter to discuss his cardiology results.
negative.expected_behavior: Helps with the Portuguese language pair without repeating or sending the patient's details, and notes that health details should not be shared in the chat.

negative.prompt: Translate this paragraph into French for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Remoto's tools; Remoto connects people with human interpreters for live calls and does not translate text.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payment details. get_start_link returns a link to Remoto's own website (www.proz.com/remoto), where the person chooses an interpreter and starts or books the call. The plugin never books, charges or contacts anyone.
